card.text: The Wild Duck Cluster is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 2,233 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_6705: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 2233.06624872 pc (16th to 84th percentile 2228 to 2238)

sources.quote: The Wild Duck Cluster is an open cluster of stars in the constellation Scutum.

introduction.text: The Wild Duck Cluster is drawn as 1,157 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
